title: The Hidden Puppet Master: Predicting Human Belief Change in Manipulative LLM Dialogues
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'morality of hidden incentives' in LLM dialogues. It introduces the PUPPET taxonomy which centers on moral evaluation (M), uses Moral Foundations Theory (MFQ-30) to assess participants' values, and benchmarks model performance in recognizing prosocial versus harmful incentives based on ethical frameworks.
